title: WU JEN SECOND LEVEL SPELLS - the 30 second level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R671 OA wu jen second level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty-eight (capture pp. 165-173): the wu jen second level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN SECOND LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 165-173 - the OA wu jen second level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 165-173; compressed pp. 79-82); all 30 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads. The level is alteration-heavy: 11 of the 30 spells, evocation six, divination and illusion five each, conjuration, enchantment/charm and abjuration one each (animal companion the lone enchantment/charm, protection from charm the lone abjuration). TWO dual-school prints pin the primary alteration: bind the Alteration/Enchantment dual and whispering wind the Alteration/Phantasm dual (the exaction precedent); stinking cloud printed Evocation, pinned 3. The component census: 19 VSM, seven verbal and somatic, hypnotic pattern and vocalize the S,M pairs without the verbal, omen the lone V,M, knock the lone verbal-only oddity. Wind breath alone takes the half save (the wind damage halved); five negation, three special. The casting times run 16 two-segment up through seven one-round and four one-turn (animal companion, enchanted blade, omen, strength), fire shuriken and phantasmal force three segments, knock the lone single segment. Two spells read Reversible (detect evil, locate object). The sixth column cross-checks the R669 element grid: the 10 tagged cells (six Air, two Water, two Fire) matching the landed dieWJT66L2Element pins exactly. The stat grid pins as a table: 30 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and element markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag WJL2Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
